Catalog.title: Neptune electric three-wheelers: compare all models
Catalog.intro: Neptune makes electric three-wheelers for Sri Lankan drivers and businesses. The Long Range 300 km is our passenger model for full-day hire, tourism and intercity work, with up to 300 km per charge and a 20 kWh LiFePO4 battery. The new Neptune EV Cargo carries up to 500 kg in a heavy-duty box, with an optional rooftop solar system for extra daily range. 200 km and 120 km passenger models are coming soon. Every model has a 24-month / 50,000 km vehicle warranty and a 5-year battery warranty. Compare the key figures below, then open a model for full specifications, prices and finance options.

HomeFaq.title: Electric three-wheeler questions, answered
HomeFaq.intro: The questions drivers ask us most. See the full FAQ for finance, solar, Cargo Mode and more.

top.question: How far can a Neptune electric three-wheeler go on one charge?
top.answer: The Neptune Long Range is rated for up to 300 km per charge; real range is usually 250–300 km depending on load, speed, road and weather. The EV Cargo does about 100 km on battery, and up to 350 km with its optional rooftop solar system.

top.question: How much does an electric three-wheeler cost in Sri Lanka?
top.answer: The Neptune Long Range 300 km is Rs. 2,675,000 including VAT, with a Rs. 605,000 down payment. The new Neptune EV Cargo is Rs. 1,775,000 on a limited-time offer (Rs. 1,000,000 off Rs. 2,775,000).

top.question: Is an electric three-wheeler cheaper to run than petrol?
top.answer: Yes. Garudan's figures show about 5,500 km a month for around Rs. 12,000 of electricity (about Rs. 2.2 per km), with no engine oil, grease, clutch or gear cables to replace. Your saving depends on your tariff, distance and driving.

top.question: Can I finance or lease a Neptune?
top.answer: Yes. Garudan offers interest-free financing of up to Rs. 1,000,000 (Rs. 20,000 a month for 50 months) for low-income families who drive a three-wheeler, limited to the first 200 families. Bank and leasing finance is also available; try our calculator.

top.question: What is the battery warranty?
top.answer: The LiFePO4 battery has a 5-year warranty with unlimited kilometres. The vehicle is covered for 24 months or 50,000 km, whichever comes first, when serviced at authorised Garudan dealers.

top.question: Can I test drive before buying?
top.answer: Yes. Use the Book a Test Drive form, call 021 785 6180 or 077 396 9427, or visit our Mount Lavinia head office or Jaffna dealer.

items.answer: The Neptune Long Range 300 km is Rs. 2,675,000 including VAT, with a Rs. 605,000 down payment. The new Neptune EV Cargo is Rs. 1,775,000 on a limited-time offer (Rs. 1,000,000 off Rs. 2,775,000).

items.question: Can I finance or lease a Neptune?
items.answer: Yes. Garudan offers interest-free financing of up to Rs. 1,000,000 (Rs. 20,000 a month for 50 months) for low-income families who drive a three-wheeler, limited to the first 200 families. Bank and leasing finance is also available; try our calculator.

items.question: Will Neptune prices go up?
items.answer: Raw material, parts and battery costs in Sri Lanka are rising, so NEPTUNE EV prices may increase next month. Booking now secures today’s price.

items.question: How far can a Neptune electric three-wheeler go on one charge?
items.answer: The Neptune Long Range is rated for up to 300 km per charge; real range is usually 250–300 km depending on load, speed, road and weather. The EV Cargo does about 100 km on battery, and up to 350 km with its optional rooftop solar system.

items.question: How long does charging take?
items.answer: About 6 hours from 20% to 100% using the on-board charger and a properly earthed 220–240 V home socket (a slow charge takes about 12 hours). Charging overnight is enough for a full working day.

items.question: Do I need a special charger at home?
items.answer: No. Neptune has an on-board charger and a 32 A AC charging socket, so it charges from a standard, properly earthed 220–240 V home supply. Ask an electrician to check the socket and wiring first.

items.question: Is an electric three-wheeler cheaper to run than petrol?
items.answer: Yes. Garudan's figures show about 5,500 km a month for around Rs. 12,000 of electricity (about Rs. 2.2 per km), with no engine oil, grease, clutch or gear cables to replace. Your saving depends on your tariff, distance and driving.

items.question: Can a Neptune charge with solar power?
items.answer: Yes, the Neptune EV Cargo offers an optional 620 W rooftop solar system (Rs. 150,000) that adds about 50 km of driving a day. It tops up the battery while you drive and park, but does not replace overnight charging.

items.question: What is the battery warranty?
items.answer: The LiFePO4 battery has a 5-year warranty with unlimited kilometres. The vehicle is covered for 24 months or 50,000 km, whichever comes first, when serviced at authorised Garudan dealers.

items.question: Where can I service my Neptune?
items.answer: At our head office (No 13, Galle Road, Mount Lavinia) and authorised Garudan service dealers, including our Jaffna dealer. Use the service coupons in your Service Book from the first 1,000 km service onwards.

items.question: Can I use it as a taxi or for deliveries?
items.answer: Yes. The Long Range seats the driver plus three passengers for hire and tourism, and the EV Cargo carries up to 500 kg for deliveries. Check route and licensing rules with the relevant Sri Lankan authority for your use.

items.question: What is Neptune Cargo Mode?
items.answer: Fold the rear seats of the Neptune Long Range back and the cabin becomes a secure goods area in moments, so one vehicle can earn from passenger hires and deliveries. Rated payload is 320 kg.

items.question: What is the difference between the Neptune models?
items.answer: The Long Range 300 km is our passenger model with the longest range. The EV Cargo has a heavy-duty box, 500 kg payload, an automatic gearbox and a rooftop solar option. 200 km and 120 km passenger models are coming soon.

items.question: Can I test drive before buying?
items.answer: Yes. Use the Book a Test Drive form, call 021 785 6180 or 077 396 9427, or visit our Mount Lavinia head office or Jaffna dealer.
